notes.title: Celebrate London Games Festival with Bramble – Now 80% Off!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that Bramble: The Mountain King is proudly taking part in the 10th Anniversary of the London Games Festival. In celebration, [i][b]you can grab the game at a massive 80% discount from April 2 to April 13[/b][/i]!

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LondonGamesFestival2025

[h2]Buy Bramble: The Mountain King for 80% Off[/h2]

If you haven’t experienced Bramble yet, now is the perfect time to begin your dark and haunting journey. Step into the shoes of Olle, a determined boy on a quest to save his sister from a fearsome troll. As you explore breathtaking environments, you’ll encounter mysterious creatures inspired by Nordic folklore—some friendly, many fearsome. Caution is your best ally; you never know what’s lurking around the corner or beneath the surface.

Armed with the Spark of Courage, you’ll be able to tackle a variety of epic boss battles and discover the story’s many twists. But remember, courage without kindness can lead you astray. Explore, strategize, and survive in this immersive world where every choice matters.

Don’t miss out on this thrilling adventure—[b]especially at 80% off for a limited time[/b]. We can’t wait to see you in Bramble: The Mountain King!

notes.title: Patch Notes for PC - 21st June 2023
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've pushed a new patch live today for Bramble: The Mountain King on Steam. The reception to the game has been absolutely fantastic, and we thank everyone for playing and for the kind words relayed to the development team.

We hope these changes help fix these issues that some players have been facing!
___________________________________________________________________

- Fixed an issue where some players using keyboards were unable to complete the QTE’s that required you to push down on several keys at the same time

- Made it easier to climb walls and other surfaces

- Made it possible to climb on to “rocking boat” in Swamp level from the side where you detach the Bramble from it

- Addressed the confusion caused by the puzzle in the prince's room by removing the extra holes in the grandfather clock

- Made it easier to jump on the “floating boxes” in Swamp level

- Fixed a bug where the final boss would not advance to its second stage if you shot the flowers while they were closed

- Fixed a bug where the “flower monster” would not react to you if you reset the level in “Tuva”

- Fixed a bug where the flashbacks were not showing up if you died during the sequence in “Dream 3”

- Fixed a misspelling of a name in the credits

- Made it more clear where to climb in the “Butcher boss” area

- Fixed a bug where some bramble and the scepter from the final boss was visible after they were not supposed to

- Fixed a bug where the speed of the minecart in troll forest was dependent on your fps

- Fixed different collision issues

- Fixed a bug where the zombies would stop chasing you sometimes if you hit a collision box

- Fixed a bug where Lillemor would run in a circle if you skipped the belltower cinematic

- Made it easier for the gnomes to not get stuck at the last trap where you try to avoid the bear traps

- Fixed a bug where an ingredient could be falsely automatically added after you made an incorrect potion

- Made it more clear that gnomes were killed if hit by bear traps

- Added planks going into the swamp stealth part to lead the player towards the first hidden planks section

- Updated default settings for steam deck certification

___________________________________________________________________

notes.title: Patch Notes for PC - 10th May 2023
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've pushed a patch live today for Bramble: The Mountain King on Steam. The reception to the game has been absolutely fantastic, and we thank everyone for playing and for the kind words relayed to the development team.

However, we have had a few reports of issues that players have been facing, and wanted to work to fix these to better improve the general experience of all of our amazing players!

___________________________________________________________________

- Fix an issue where the game sometimes would not save, and upon resuming the game after closing it down the player’s progress would only be in Nearby Forest

- Fix an issue on steam deck and some PCs where the video on top of the lighthouse in Pesta did not play, and softlocks the player if it did not play. Now, the video might still not play on those machines, but in case it doesn’t play the video is skipped and the player can resume playing normally

- Fix an issue where the main menu would receive input while fading in, and the “New Game” button would be auto-focused. This would make players accidentally press the “New Game” button while the menu is fading in. Now, the menu should not be intractable during the fade-in, and the “Continue” button should be auto-focused instead if the player has a save file with progress 

- Improve the visibility of the hidden planks in the swamp by increasing the emissivity of the material

___________________________________________________________________

notes.title: The Nordic Lore of Trolls
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40686742/4f0af6b7727efbf3a58a88bd8175f38d9ad01278.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

Bramble: The Mountain King is home to a wide array of creatures. Whilst some may be friendly, others are not - be careful who you trust as you journey to save your sister Lillemor.

[b]Talk of Trolls in Norse mythology can be tracked back all the way to the 13th century.[/b] These evil creatures feature heavily throughout Scandinavian folklore and stories - the development team on Bramble: The Mountain King drew heavily on these when designing the Trolls in the game.

Check out some of the Nordic lore behind these dark creatures, and how Bramble: The Mountain King draws inspiration from Scandinavian folklore, in the video below:

notes.title: Screenshot Competition Winners
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Last month we ran a [b][url=https://gleam.io/competitions/OQmbv-bramble-the-mountain-king-photoscreenshot-competition]Screenshot Competition[/url][/b] challenging our community capture their best [b]Bramble: The Mountain King[/b] screenshots from the demo during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b].

The team were looking for screenshots that had nice composition and ones that capture a sense of what Bramble is about. These could be calm, terrifying, screenshots of a nice vista or even the characters that you’ll meet!

We received so many amazing entries and it was incredibly difficult to choose our winners. However, we felt that the three winning entries did an amazing job at capturing the awe-inspiring world of Bramble, along with the immense scale and a sense of the journey that Olle is embarking upon.

Check out the winning screenshots below:

Aired at [b]The MIX Direct Spring 2023 Showcase[/b], check out the new Developer Commentary Breakdown of Bramble: The Mountain King.

Follow along as [b]Fredrik Selldén[/b], Design Director, Co-Founder and CEO of Dimfrost Studio, takes us through the Nordic folklore that inspired the team to create this dark, Swedish adventure.

Under the [b]International Innovators category[/b], we are delighted to share this news with everyone and see the game receive this amazing recognition.

[h3]A little bit about London Games Festival[/h3]

[i]The London Games Festival 2023 runs from Wednesday 29 March to Sunday 9 April. The festival’s Official Selection returns with over 30 games and apps representing quality, innovation and diversity. The selection highlights games across five categories: Best of British, High Energy, Historical Adventure, International Innovators and Pixel Power.

Once again, the games will be presented via a dedicated online showcase site available from the start of the festival, with associated store promotions at digital retailers and online profile videos produced by London Games Festival. Some of the titles will release special content during the festival period, while others have free demos available.[/i]

More information about the London Games Festival 2023 can be found [b][url=https://games.london/global-games-creators-picked-for-lgfs-annual-official-selection/]here[/url][/b].

notes.title: Nearly 20K Downloads of the Bramble Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40686742/dfe06fcdf3b682594b4d12e41743b7228227c632.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We wanted to say a massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who has played the Nacken's Pond demo since we launched it on Halloween!

Our original target was to hit [b]10k downloads[/b] of the demo, but you all smashed that way sooner than we'd expected! 

So much so, in the time it's taken us in the past couple weeks to process this and get ready to post about it, we're now quickly approaching [u][b]20k downloads![/b][/u]

[h3][b][i]This is such an amazing achievement, and from the teams at Dimfrost and Merge Games, we want to thank you all so much for the love and support you given to us and the game.[/i][/b][/h3]

You have therefore also unlocked our [b]stretch goal content[/b] - we will be giving you more information about this, [i]and something special[/i], in Decemeber. Keep your eyes peeled!

Thank you again for helping us reach this incredible achievement. If you haven't played the demo yet, [b]you can still download and play through the mysterious and murky Nacken's Pond[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623940/Bramble_The_Mountain_King/
